name: Housing Starts & Building Permits
consensus_source: No consensus found for October 2026 in a targeted search on 2026-11-18
read: October starts rose 9.9% to 1,309k SAAR from a revised 1,191k, but permits fell 7.4% to 1,295k from 1,398k. Permits lead starts by about a month, so the rebound looks fragile. No consensus found.

reasons: no consensus available; surprise not assessed
